source.before: Bruce Springsteen had some words to say at the 2026 MoMA film benefit, and he happened to go after one of my favorite movies of all time. As someone who came up at the Jersey Shore, The Boss had a very specific grievance with the original summer blockbuster, 'Jaws.'
source.highlight: “In June of 1975 I went to a small theater directly across from the Atlantic Ocean and I saw 'Jaws.' I was 25 years old and one of the great pleasures on the Jersey shore in 1975 was night swimming,” Bruce said.
New Jersey gets official state microbe: Streptomyces griseus
source.after: A microorganism that played a role in treating tuberculosis is now officially recognized as New Jersey's state microbe. Gov. Phil Murphy signed a bill Friday giving the distinction to Streptomyces griseus.

source.highlight: The music recording industry was born in Camden. This Berlin museum traces RCA-Victor's rise and fall
source.after: A museum about the RCA-Victor company has opened in Berlin, New Jersey, just a few miles from where the stereo and TV equipment maker was born in Camden. … The museum also has one of the earliest electric pianos from the 1930s, which sort of works.

source.highlight: A new study from LendingTree ranks New Jersey number one for the worst drivers in the country.
source.after: According to the study, New Jersey drivers recorded 56.9 driving incidents per 1,000 drivers through August 2026. … To be fair, LendingTree's study is based on insurance inquiry data from QuoteWizard, not some nationwide experiment in which researchers actually put drivers behind the wheel and watched them attempt to navigate the Flemington Circle.

source.highlight: Comedian and New Jersey native Jon Stewart shared a video on Instagram Wednesday night showing a seal bobbing above water and the caption, "New pal alert!! Jersey Shore Novembers!!!" Commenters quickly flocked to offer their opinions on where the clip may be shot.
source.after: Clearly, Jon Stewart spotted one of the Sandy Hook seals, and we can head back home for Thanksgiving with joy in our hearts.
